say:1:1231181001:1.text: Certainly, and the most famous tour guide in all of Rustport is standing right before you.
say:1:1231181001:1.source_cn: 当然，而且锈锚港曾经最有名的导游正站在你的眼前。

say:2:1231181002:1.text: There's nothing about this port that I don't know! I even know exactly how many maintenance entrances the sewer system has!
say:2:1231181002:1.source_cn: 整个港口，就没有我不知道的！就连下水道有几个维修入口，...

say:3:1231181003:1.text: For newcomers to Rustport who need a gentle push in the right direction, I'm your man!
say:3:1231181003:1.source_cn: 对于初到锈锚港，不知道该往什么地方去的游客，我将是他们...

say:4:1231181004:1.text: ...At least, that was my old intro. Alas, now there are no more outsiders, and I haven't received a tip in ages. It's a real struggle these days.
say:4:1231181004:1.source_cn: ……曾经是这样。现在，唉，根本没有外来人了。我已经好久...
